decks.summary: Dark Horse Lola who fights and investigates equally well: Improvisation plays anything for free, passive boosts cut down on role switching, and Machete or Shrivelling handle enemies.
The level 0 start of a Will to Survive Lola: Dark Horse boosts, Leo De Luca and Quick Thinking for extra actions, Fire Axe and Meat Cleaver to fight; tested on Hard in two-player.
Beginner Lola from one Core, Dunwich and Carcosa built for clues in multiplayer: Milan, Magnifying Glass, Flashlight and Rite of Seeking, with Improvisation to switch roles cheaply.
Edge of the Earth Lola who kills early with four Sled Dogs, Rod of Animalism and Boxing Gloves, using Synergy cards and In the Thick of It for a big jump by the second scenario.
The upgraded Miracle Lola: Will to Survive with Ace in the Hole, Borrowed Time and Leo De Luca for 7 to 12 action turns that pass every test, drawing her whole deck early.
Solo Lola racing to install two Crystalline Elder Signs and Dark Horse for high stats, then evading and oversucceeding as a Rogue and Survivor; a short guide.
Balanced Dark Horse Lola who keeps Beat Cop and Milan boosts in any role, with Machete and Magnifying Glass, and A Chance Encounter to swap allies.
Infinite-draw Lola under Will to Survive: Knowledge is Power, Practice Makes Perfect and Three Aces loop through her deck for clues; very hard to pilot and weak against enemies.
Ally-and-tome Lola: Charon's Obol with Whitton Greene, Art Students and Laboratory Assistants for a wide table, Luparas for enemies, and Schoffner's Catalogue for money.
Five-class solo Lola built to use every color: Crystalline Elder Signs and Ace of Swords for stats, Streetwise and "Watch this!" for money, Derringers and Knife to fight, Magnifying Glass for clues.
